summary: Completed iteration99 backend+frontend runtime testing on external preview URL. Fixed and executed iter99 auth smoke tests against actual username/Bearer JWT contract (3/3 pass). Frontend release-notice flow validated with a MOCKED delayed /api/auth/me=401 stale-token repro and real login; single v1.5.1 notice shown, no duplicate on reload/relogin, excluded kids/music/trivia routes showed no Vesper notice. Top-nav motion/transitions validated after forcing top layout; manual onboarding replay control remains not interactable in runtime check.

ui_bugs.issue: Replay button exists in DOM but is not visible/clickable in tested runtime; onboarding overlay could not be opened from Settings via automation.

integration_issues.issue: Cloud restore dialog did not appear for testuser in this environment, so 'Restore then show release popup' ordering could not be fully verified with real snapshot data.

action_items: Fix Settings replay-onboarding button visibility/clickability so manual welcome tour replay is reliably usable.
Run one real-user retest with cloud snapshot present to verify release popup waits until restore dialog is resolved (Restore path).
Optional: add deterministic QA hook/seed for cloud snapshot presence to make this sequence testable without live account-state dependency.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is very large (1000+ lines) and mixes boot-time side effects, routing, and product-mode guards; split into focused modules to reduce regression risk in auth/release sequencing changes.
server.py is very large (5600+ lines); continued growth increases integration risk and slows targeted regression analysis—modularize by domain routers/services.
Auth contract is clearly Bearer JWT/localStorage (not httpOnly-cookie); tests must stay aligned to auth_router.py contract to avoid false failures.
seed_data_creation: Browser-local seeds used for nav/profile readiness only: onnowtv-profiles-v1:testuser, onnowtv-active-profile-v1:testuser=p-test-1, onnowtv-nav-layout:p-test-1=top, sessionStorage vesper-e2e=1. No server-side seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Release modal fit checks passed with no internal overflow detected across tested viewports; desktop panel measured ~1120x452.9. Required screenshots were captured at /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter99/release_modal_1920x800.jpeg and /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter99/release_modal_390x844.jpeg. Top-nav transitions observed as marker transform 160ms and button transform/color 120ms after forcing top layout and profile seed. Duplicate release popup repro was covered with MOCKED delayed /api/auth/me=401; real login produced one notice and no duplicate after reload/relogin. Stop repeating settings-replay selector attempts without a UI fix (3 attempts already made).
rca of the issue: Primary unresolved issue is manual replay onboarding control not actionable at runtime: selector resolves in DOM, but Playwright reports element not visible; direct visible-node click fallback also found no visible candidate. This indicates section visibility/layout-state mismatch (hidden section or occluded control) rather than auth/API failure. Reproduction: login -> /settings -> attempt click [data-testid='settings-replay-onboarding'] after navigating welcome-tour section -> click blocked/not visible, onboarding overlay never appears. Mitigation: ensure help section activation makes replay button visibly rendered and pointer/focus reachable.
